title: StabilityBase
description: Layer-agnostic mixin contributing the optional `stability` maturity marker and an optional `description` to any DNA primitive. Composed via `allOf` by every per-primitive schema across the operational, product (core/api/ui), and technical layers. It is the single source of truth for the maturity enum — kept in lock-step with the `STABILITIES` constant in @dna-codes/dna-core. Pure mixin: it declares no `required` fields and locks neither `additionalProperties` nor `unevaluatedProperties`, so composing it never rejects a primitive's own fields.

stability.description: Optional declared concept maturity (Kubernetes API-maturity model). Orthogonal to schema version. When present on a primitive that seeds a registry type, it flows into registry seeding as the seeded type's stability; when absent, the registry's seeding defaults apply (foundational types `stable`, everything else `experimental`).

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this primitive represents.
